title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Public Opinion Communication
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Communication with the Public

Fa Fa [2009] No. 20

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Communication with the Public of the Supreme People's Court are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation in light of actual work.

April 13, 2009

Opinions on Further Strengthening the Work of Communication with the Public

Strengthening the work of communication with the public is a concrete manifestation of adhering to the principle of seeking truth from facts and the mass line, an inevitable requirement for thoroughly implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development, and an important measure for smooth judicial democratic channels. To further promote the democratization and scientific decision-making in judicial affairs, better accept democratic supervision, deepen judicial transparency, promote judicial fairness, enhance judicial credibility, and continuously meet the new demands and expectations of the people regarding the work of the People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward on further strengthening the work of communication with the public.

I. Fully Recognizing the Great Significance of Further Strengthening the Work of Communication with the Public

(1) Further strengthening the work of communication with the public is a key link in practicing justice for the people and promoting judicial democracy. Adjudication and enforcement work involves all aspects of social life and is closely related to the vital interests of the broad masses of the people. Protecting the rights and interests of the people in accordance with the law is both the duty and the essential requirement of the People's Courts. To better practice the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," and to safeguard and protect the people's legitimate rights including the right to know, the right to participate, the right to express, and the right to supervise, we must adhere to a people-oriented approach, extensively and deeply listen to public opinion, understand public sentiment, pay attention to people's livelihood, respect the views of the masses through concrete actions, promote judicial democracy, and fully reflect the people-oriented advantages of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics.

(2) Further strengthening the work of communication with the public is an important safeguard for effectively performing the functions of adjudication and enforcement, improving judicial transparency, optimizing judicial decision-making, and achieving the goal of closing cases and resolving disputes. Handling cases according to law is the primary task of the People's Courts. To effectively carry out adjudication and enforcement work and promote the unity of social and legal effects of case handling, we must adopt various methods, connect with reality, go deep among the masses, vigorously promote the fine traditions of people's justice, strive to innovate, actively implement the system of open trials, and actively improve various litigation measures that are convenient and beneficial to the people. In all aspects of adjudication and enforcement, we must fully listen to the opinions and suggestions of the masses and all sectors of society, promote the scientific nature of judicial decision-making, and continuously meet the new demands and expectations of the people for judicial work.

(3) Further strengthening the work of communication with the public is an effective way to promote judicial integrity, enhance the quality of the judicial team, and improve judicial credibility. By strengthening the work of communication with the public, mobilizing social forces, and actively accepting external supervision, it helps to promote the team building of the People's Courts, improve judges' case-handling ability and mass work capability, continuously improve work style and discipline, establish a good image of justice, efficiency, serving the people, and integrity, continuously enhance judicial credibility, promote the construction of socialist democracy and the legal system, and promote the scientific development of the People's Courts themselves, thereby better serving the scientific development of the economy and society.

II. Basic Requirements for Further Strengthening the Work of Communication with the Public

(1) Focus on establishing a long-term mechanism for communication and exchange with the broad masses of the people and all sectors of society. People's Courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of being scientific, smooth, pragmatic, effective, and convenient, continuously improve and innovate working mechanisms, broaden channels for communication with the public, maximize the understanding and grasp of social conditions and public opinion, maximize the facilitation of the people's exercise of rights, expression of opinions, and supervision of justice, making public opinion an important reference for judicial decision-making and an important criterion for testing work effectiveness, so that various decisions conform to the demands of the masses and comply with judicial rules.

(2) Vigorously expand the scope of targets for communication with the public. When determining work ideas, improving convenience measures, and evaluating judicial effects, People's Courts at all levels shall, as needed, adopt various means and methods to extensively solicit opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society, including deputies to People's Congresses, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), democratic parties, social organizations, experts and scholars, other legal professionals, and grassroots masses. Special attention shall be paid to going deep into enterprises, communities, and villages to timely understand the opinions and voices of the broadest grassroots masses.

(3) Improve and perfect the working mechanism for liaison with deputies to People's Congresses and members of the CPPCC. Give full play to the functions of the People's Courts' People's Supervision Work Office, improve and perfect the methods and means of liaison, and on the basis of regular liaison, according to the work priorities determined each year, adopt various flexible and effective methods to brief deputies to People's Congresses and members of the CPPCC on work situations and solicit opinions and suggestions.

(4) Improve and perfect the communication and coordination mechanism with democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, personages without party affiliation, and social organizations. In accordance with the principle of "being proactive, timely communication, full consultation, pragmatic and effective," formulate relevant work rules, designate specific institutions and personnel responsible for communication and coordination with democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and personages without party affiliation. Through establishing regular liaison systems, joint research systems, and other means, brief work, listen to opinions and suggestions, and jointly study solutions to problems. By strengthening daily exchanges, setting up liaison officers, and other means, carry out regular work communication with social organizations such as trade unions, Communist Youth League, and women's federations.

(5) Improve and perfect the system of specially invited advisors. The Supreme People's Court shall earnestly implement the "Working Regulations of the Supreme People's Court on Specially Invited Advisors," expand the representative fields for the selection and appointment of specially invited advisors, further strengthen regular communication and liaison with specially invited advisors, pay attention to listening to their opinions and suggestions on court work, and promptly transform them into judicial decision-making opinions through appropriate means. At the same time, vigorously support and actively cooperate with specially invited advisors in carrying out their work, and strive to create conditions and provide convenience for strengthening communication and liaison between specially invited advisors and grassroots masses.

(6) Improve and perfect the system of people's assessors. Effectively implement the "Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Improving the System of People's Assessors," the "Implementing Opinions of the Supreme People's Court and the Ministry of Justice on the Selection, Training, and Assessment of People's Assessors," the "Measures of the Supreme People's Court for the Administration of People's Assessors (Trial)," and other regulations, improve and perfect the selection method and management mechanism of people's assessors, increase efforts to adjust and supplement people's assessors. Intermediate and grassroots People's Courts shall organize at least two seminars each year specifically to listen to the opinions and suggestions of people's assessors, further play their role as bridges and ties, give full play to their advantages of coming from the masses, being close to the masses, and serving the masses, understand public sentiment through them, publicize the law, and maximize the function of the people's assessor system in communicating with the public.

(7) Improve and innovate the mechanism for court leading cadres to go deep into grassroots to listen to public opinion. Establish a system of grassroots contact points for court leading cadres. Leading cadres of the Supreme People's Court and high People's Courts shall regularly go deep into grassroots contact points to conduct research and surveys. Further promote the activities of judges entering enterprises, villages, and communities. Grand judges and senior judges shall go deep into grassroots to listen to public opinion, understand public sentiment, and timely and accurately grasp the new demands and expectations of the people for judicial work.

(8) Improve and innovate the mechanism for soliciting public opinions in judicial decision-making. Further promote the institutionalization and standardization of soliciting public opinions in the process of formulating judicial interpretations and judicial guidance opinions. Explore the establishment of court open days, invite the public to visit courts and observe trials, and actively carry out legal publicity. Explore the establishment of grassroots judicial service networks, employ respected, enthusiastic, and capable members of villages and communities as judicial assistants to assist People's Courts in resolving disputes and represent the masses in reflecting opinions. Select grassroots cadres and masses as specially invited mediators and enforcement liaison officers to make judicial work closer to the masses and more convenient. Strengthen the system for collecting public opinions online, focus on building court websites, enrich online information release, online public opinion surveys, and other columns to facilitate the masses in expressing opinions and suggestions.

(9) Improve and perfect the online mechanism for communication with the public. Actively promote the system of online disclosure of adjudication and enforcement information. Increase the intensity of live webcasting of court trials. Main leaders of People's Courts at all levels shall participate in at least one activity of direct online exchange, communication, and interaction with netizens each year, extensively listening to netizens' opinions. For public opinions learned and feedback received, information can be provided to the masses through online Q&A or individual communication to let them know the situation and feel the court's respect for public opinion. Improve the system for accepting public complaints through the internet and other channels. Courts with conditions may set up dedicated email addresses to collect opinions and suggestions from the masses.

(10) Improve and perfect the communication and coordination mechanism between People's Courts and news media. Use newspapers, radio, television, and other media to release work reports of the People's Courts, major judicial decisions, and case trial information, increase publicity efforts, and provide the public with timely and accurate judicial information services. Further strengthen communication and exchange with news media, earnestly implement the "Press Release System of the People's Courts" and the "Supplementary Provisions on Further Improving the Press Release System of the Supreme People's Court," and improve the press conference system. Pay attention to the guiding role of news media in public opinion, actively collect public opinion, understand public sentiment, and publicize the law. The Supreme People's Court and each high People's Court shall organize at least two meetings each year specifically to discuss and analyze various public opinions and grasp the dynamics of judicial work.

(11) Improve and innovate the mechanism for transforming public opinion. Achieve the institutionalization of the transformation of public opinion. Timely summarize, screen, classify, and analyze the collected opinions and suggestions, and transform reasonable opinions and suggestions into content for work rectification. Where opinions and suggestions involve legislative amendments, submit them to the state authority. Where they involve policy formulation, submit them to relevant decision-making departments. Where they involve the formulation or revision of judicial interpretations, submit them level by level to the Supreme People's Court. Regard the absorption and transformation of public opinion as an important indicator for evaluating work, carry out regular public opinion surveys and opinion solicitation activities, and effectively solve existing problems.

(12) Improve and innovate the feedback mechanism to the masses on work rectification. When issuing major judicial decisions, special explanations may be given during press releases and other links regarding the listening and absorption of public opinion during the decision-making process. For the rectification of other specific matters, feedback may be provided to the masses through media releases, written replies, on-site return visits, or organization of seminars, to seek understanding and support and enhance judicial credibility.

III. Effectively Strengthen Organizational Leadership and Strive for Practical Results

(1) People's Courts at all levels shall attach great importance to the work of communication with the public, include the strengthening of this work in their important agenda, earnestly study and solve various problems arising in practice, and pay attention to work effectiveness. Leading cadres of People's Courts at all levels shall take the lead in doing this work well, position themselves correctly, set an example, earnestly implement various systems and measures, and ensure timely transformation of social conditions and public opinion into important guidance and reference for judicial decision-making.

(2) People's Courts at all levels shall actively do a good job in the organization, implementation, and comprehensive coordination of specific measures for communication with the public, ensure implementation at each level, and ensure that measures, responsibilities, and work are in place. People's Courts at all levels shall designate specific institutions and specific personnel responsible for organizing and coordinating this work. Earnestly accumulate experience, timely summarize various good practices, pay attention to doing a good job in news publicity, and allow more people to learn about, participate in, and supervise judicial decision-making in accordance with the law.

(3) Higher-level People's Courts shall strengthen guidance to lower-level People's Courts, organize regular supervision and inspection, and timely notify the results of supervision and inspection. While actively improving and perfecting their own work of communication with the public, the Supreme People's Court and high People's Courts shall promptly summarize typical experiences of People's Courts in various localities and promote continuous new progress in the work of communication with the public.
